speaker: (the porter)
text: Your name, sir. Or the name you have brought with the paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shakespeare. Of the company. I have a paper for Master Florio, to give or not as he judges.

speaker: (the porter)
text: I know the name. Or I say I do, which will serve at a lodge.

speaker: (the porter)
text: My lord is at court. Master Florio is within, and teaching. You will not go up to either.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not come to go up. The bench will do.

speaker: (the porter)
text: Sit, then. Four minutes is a lodge. I am not asking you further in than this bench.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four minutes. The paper stays. I do not stay with it.

speaker: (the porter)
text: Sealed, and small. I can see that. I do not ask what it says.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not. It is for him to give or not. I have sat the four minutes.

speaker: (the porter)
text: Then the gate is behind you, sir. The same way you came.
